files.content:
"use client";

import { Stack, Switch, Text } from "@chakra-ui/react"
import { colorPalettes } from "@/components/rendyn-libraries/chakra/upstream/lib/color-palettes"

export const SwitchWithColors = () => {
  return (
    <Stack gap="2" align="flex-start">
      {colorPalettes.map((colorPalette) => (
        <Stack
          align="center"
          key={colorPalette}
          direction="row"
          gap="10"
          px="4"
        >
          <Text minW="8ch">{colorPalette}</Text>

          <Switch.Root colorPalette={colorPalette}>
            <Switch.HiddenInput />
            <Switch.Control />
            <Switch.Label />
          </Switch.Root>

          <Switch.Root colorPalette={colorPalette} defaultChecked>
            <Switch.HiddenInput />
            <Switch.Control />
            <Switch.Label />
          </Switch.Root>
        </Stack>
      ))}
    </Stack>
  )
}

"use client";

import { Switch } from "@chakra-ui/react"
import { HiCheck, HiX } from "react-icons/hi"

export const SwitchWithThumbIndicator = () => {
  return (
    <Switch.Root size="lg">
      <Switch.HiddenInput />
      <Switch.Control>
        <Switch.Thumb>
          <Switch.ThumbIndicator fallback={<HiX color="black" />}>
            <HiCheck />
          </Switch.ThumbIndicator>
        </Switch.Thumb>
      </Switch.Control>
      <Switch.Label>Switch me</Switch.Label>
    </Switch.Root>
  )
}

"use client";

import { Icon, Switch } from "@chakra-ui/react"
import { FaMoon, FaSun } from "react-icons/fa"

export const SwitchWithTrackIndicator = () => {
  return (
    <Switch.Root colorPalette="blue" size="lg">
      <Switch.HiddenInput />
      <Switch.Control>
        <Switch.Thumb />
        <Switch.Indicator fallback={<Icon as={FaMoon} color="gray.400" />}>
          <Icon as={FaSun} color="yellow.400" />
        </Switch.Indicator>
      </Switch.Control>
      <Switch.Label>Switch me</Switch.Label>
    </Switch.Root>
  )
}

# Chakra UI Switch

Turn a setting on or off.

## Installation

- Complete MIT examples with a ChakraProvider using defaultSystem.
- Reuse the application-level ChakraProvider when integrating; keep HiddenInput in checkbox and switch compositions for keyboard and form semantics.

- Copy every returned file and preserve the MIT licence notice.
- Render the returned preview.tsx example, or integrate the example into your existing provider.
